style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: the falcon works his whole body every beat; the camera never stops, new shot size every beat, in a constant orbit round the falcon; the falcon fills half the frame
character: the falcon: peregrine, black moustache stripes, yellow feet, straw sun hat with ribbon, striped swim ring round his body, leather leash tied to one foot; ONE pelican boss: grey suit and tie, thick falconry glove on his left wing, tasselled leather hood hanging from the glove cuff from the first frame, throat pouch bulging with banknotes
props: ONE coin lure: plain coins on a cord; furry mic bottom right
environment: sunny office rooftop, blue sea on the horizon

audio.delivery: brisk dry male voice, weary, 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: DU-mal, po-le-CHU v OT-pusk. o-ka-ZA-los', ya lish do-le-TA-yu ot zar-PLA-ty do zar-PLA-ty
audio.pacing: 0.5-6.15 one continuous flow, no pause inside; after 6.15 not a word, sfx go on
audio.sfx: wing thrashes, leash twang, coin jingle

timeline.a: the falcon already hovers huge in frame, wings thrashing, sun hat flapping, swim ring bouncing, leash from his foot humming taut; the pelican just below leans back on the short leash
timeline.c: close, low angle, camera already moving

timeline.a: the falcon spreads his wings full width and strains up toward the sea, beak opening on every syllable; the pelican pulls the coin lure from his pocket
timeline.c: medium, camera orbits the falcon, sea opens behind

timeline.a: the falcon swings his whole body after the swinging coins, wings beating, beak opening on every syllable; the pelican lazily swings the coin lure
timeline.c: medium, high angle, falcon fills the foreground

timeline.a: the falcon snaps into a short feet-first dive at the coins, beak opening on every syllable; the pelican swings the lure up close
timeline.c: close on falcon eye, coins swing past the lens

timeline.a: the pelican yanks the lure away; the falcon brakes, wings flared back, swim ring sliding to his waist, beak opening on every syllable
the pelican swings the lure again; the falcon dives after it again, beak opening on every syllable
timeline.c: close, camera orbits low round the falcon

timeline.a: the pelican coughs ONE coin out of his pouch and flips it up; the falcon snatches it mid-air with one foot, sun hat flying off
timeline.c: close, coin flies toward the lens

timeline.a: the falcon lands on the glove on one foot, coin gripped in the other, shuffling sideways, wings flapping; the pelican drops the lure and slips the hood over the falcon's head
the hooded falcon bobs his body side to side, blindly hunting; the pelican gulps the banknotes down, pouch going flat
timeline.c: medium close on the hooded falcon, pelican at frame edge

timeline.a: the swim ring deflates with a whistle; the falcon hops round and mantles his wings over the coin, pressing it to his chest
the sun hat drops from above onto the hood; the falcon rouses, shaking out every feather, coin pressed to his chest; the pelican straightens his tie
timeline.c: close, camera orbit completes the circle

must_appear: leash taut 0.0, coin dive 3.35, hood 6.9, coin to chest 8.4
negative_prompt: held mic, extra characters, slow motion, any word after 6.15, silent tail, accented Russian, letters, numbers, signs, subtitles, logo, watermark, English speech, pause inside a line, extra word, duplicate props, floating objects, falcon flying at camera, falcon frozen on the glove, far shot, wide shot, still camera, night, cut, scene change
